svg.title: DynSTEER framework overview
svg.desc: The framework compiles public task views into candidate milestone graphs, merges them by majority support, aligns closed trajectory actions with milestone stages, and dynamically adjusts judge tiers and dimension weights before advancing or stopping.

g.text: Milestone Graph Generation and Consensus Merge
Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Dynamic Control
DAG, closed actions, and decisions share the same stage coordinates.
next stage uses updated w and judge level
Low score / high u increases weight for next stage
closed action - dominator anchor - stage score - uncertainty - updated policy - stop reason
